about: --chapter on a History Claude session (3.5, K8): each chapter of claude-chapters' transcript by its anchor (an argv f*:<offset> is f<the copied transcript's inode>:<offset>): the prompt, assistant text, tool calls (a Bash command, an edit's path, other tools' input fields) and their clipped results (paired into the call's chapter; a quiet Grep error is no error), a slash command as /name args, a compaction summary; the same by session UUID and record name; an offset, inode or form not exactly an anchor is chapter gone (K14.2, K14.3); a bad anchor exits 2
